business_summary: Prebiotic soda brand offering low-sugar, high-fiber beverage alternatives for health-conscious younger adults and parents.

relevant_tags.why: The product is explicitly a prebiotic functional soda.
Positioned directly as a swap for regular soda.
Core product category is liquid beverages.
Sold as a packaged food/beverage item.
Shelf-stable soft drinks fit within pantry staples.
Targets health-conscious consumers looking for functional wellness benefits.

note_signals.why: High-frequency, impulse-friendly convenience and grocery purchases are ideal for single-pack beverage trials.
Values-driven shoppers responsive to clean-ingredient and wellness claims align perfectly with low-sugar prebiotic soda.
Active family households seeking convenience align with the target audience of parents swapping out regular soda.
Direct competitor selling functional beverages and soda alternatives, creating a conflict of interest on their thank-you page.

gate_reason: The product, pricing, and target demographics are clearly stated, allowing for immediate campaign planning and host routing.
clarifying_questions: Do you offer a subscription option for repeat purchases, and if so, is there a discount?
Are there any shipping fees or regional constraints for shipping heavy liquid cases?
What is your target customer acquisition cost (CAC) or target margin for this network?
